speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing acute diarrhea; to help you safely, could you please tell me how long this has been going on and if you have noticed any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Levofloxacin-associated C. difficile infection.

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Pelvis_CXR (to confirm prior pneumonia status)
